# Decision: One JSON document

<!-- repo-knowledge:decision -->
Status: implemented

## Problem
Existing consumers call JSON.parse on the complete stdout.

## Decision
The --json option returns one JSON document; JSONL is not supported.

## Alternatives considered
JSONL was rejected because existing consumers cannot parse it as one document.

## Consequences
Consumers retain compatibility, but streaming is unavailable.

## Evidence
The fixture demonstrates whole-output JSON parsing. No external integrations were tested.
